[[File:Queen_of_air_and_darkness.svg|thumb|200px|The Queen of Air and Darkness as it appears in certain sabacc decks]]
The '''Queen of Air and Darkness''' was a face card in the standard [[Sabacc/Legends|sabacc]] deck. It held a value of negative two; it could potentially be used to form either a [[Pure Sabacc/Legends|Pure Sabacc]] or an [[Idiot's Array/Legends|Idiot's Array]].
